exercises.instruction: Read each pair of sentences and write the second one again, beginning as shown.

items.prompt: It was difficult to open the window. → The window
answers: The window was difficult to open.

items.prompt: It’s impossible to translate some words. → Some words
answers: Some words are impossible to translate.

items.prompt: It’s expensive to maintain a car. → A
answers: A car is expensive to maintain.

items.prompt: It’s not safe to eat this meat. → This
answers: This meat isn’t safe to eat.

items.prompt: It’s easy to get to my house from here. → My
answers: My house is easy to get to from here.

exercises.instruction: Make sentences from the words in brackets.

items.prompt: It’s a very common mistake. (easy mistake / make)
answers: It’s an easy mistake to make.

items.prompt: I like living in this town. (great place / live)
answers: It’s a great place to live.

items.prompt: I wonder why she said that. (strange thing / say)
answers: It was a strange thing to say.

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences. Use: the first the second the last the only

parts:
Everybody else arrived before Paul.
Paul was
answers: the last (person) to arrive

parts:
Emily passed the exam. All the other students failed.
Emily
answers: was the only student to pass (the exam)
was the only one to pass (the exam)

parts:
I complained to the manager. Another customer had already complained.
I
answers: was the second customer to complain
was the second person to complain

parts:
Neil Armstrong walked on the moon in 1969. Nobody had done this before him.
Neil Armstrong
answers: was the first person to walk on the moon
was the first man to walk on the moon

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences using the words in brackets and a suitable verb.

parts:
I’m not surprised you’re tired after your trip.
(you / bound / tired) You’re
after such a long journey.
answers: bound to be tired

parts:
Andy has a very bad memory.
(he / sure / forget) He’s
anything you tell him.
answers: sure to forget

parts:
I don’t think you’ll need an umbrella.
(it / not / likely / rain) It’s
answers: not likely to rain
isn’t likely to rain

parts:
The holidays begin this weekend.
(there / sure / be) There’s
a lot of traffic on the roads.
answers: sure to be
